data: Partner Programs for Publishers, Creators, and Media Who Perform

FuseTwo has gathered a curated partner marketing network: publishers, creators, and media partners matched to vetted brands in the verticals they already cover. We’re selective about who we work with on both sides of the network.

Publishers and creators both add value. How they do it — and what they need from a program — are different conversations. FuseTwo handles both. Creators and publishers run through the same FuseTwo infrastructure: unified tracking, real-time reporting, and competitive commissions that help you earn faster.
What’s different is how we talk to you, what programs we match you with, and what support looks like on your end.
Publishers create content that attracts audiences, informs decisions, and increasingly shapes how brands surface in AI-driven discovery.

FuseTwo is built around that reality: with programs that compensate publishers fairly, terms that are clear before you promote anything, and brands that value the editorial relationship, not just the last click.

Creators build authority in a niche. That takes time, consistency, and a clear point of view, and it’s worth protecting. Brand partnerships are one revenue stream among many, and the wrong ones cost more than they pay.

FuseTwo vets the brands in the network for vertical fit and audience alignment before they reach you. When there’s a program match, the case for brand fit is already made. We make sure the options are worth considering.
Publishers and creators know what a good partner program looks like: clear compensation,
reliable attribution, responsive advisors, and brands that convert their audience.
FuseTwo is built around that standard.
Clear terms before you commit. Every program in the FuseTwo network has competitive compensation and no surprise reductions after you've already promoted.
FuseTwo advisors are here to help. If you have an issue or a question comes up, a real person responds in a reasonable amount of time. That's not the standard, but it should be.
Privacy-compliant, cookieless tracking means your conversions are counted accurately, even as browser tracking continues to change. You get paid for what you actually drive.
Your earnings pay out on schedule, every cycle. No follow-up required, no surprises. Payment terms are confirmed upfront, and deposits run on time.
When you join a program, the materials are waiting: product imagery, links, promotional calendars. You promote; you don't chase down assets first.
See what's converting: by brand, by campaign, by link. No waiting until the end of the month to find out your traffic didn't track. Optimize while the campaign is live.
